notes.title: CODE VEIN II - Release Date Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
A NEW FUTURE BEGINS FOR A WORLD IN PERIL IN CODE VEIN II, COMING JANUARY 2026

Rewrite History and Save the World in the Next Major RPG

[previewyoutube="rVRzh7Y640M;full"][/previewyoutube]

The new action RPG takes players on an epic journey where they wield time as a weapon, traverse through past and present versions of an explorable world and uncover a dramatic battle to save the world.  Code Vein II features action-packed RPG play with engaging combat and a deep progression system for character, weapon and ability upgrades.  Players will travel across vast environments with companions who factor large into a dynamic Partner System as they take on challenging foes and massive, unforgettable bosses. 

[hr][/hr]

Ultimate Edition


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/3f161cd222ca86814b9e55fa72e98cedbcefea38.jpg"]


The Ultimate Edition includes:

CODE VEIN II

Custom Outfit Pack: Contains 3 costume sets and 1 weapon

Expansion DLC: Mask of Idris

CODE VEIN Character Costume Set: Contains 6 costumes based on characters from the original game, CODE VEIN

CODE VEIN II Digital Mini Artbook & Soundtrack


[hr][/hr]

Deluxe Edition


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/6ac109cacf8d24f3df53411fd7038ce38e49b451.jpg"]


The Deluxe Edition includes:

CODE VEIN II

Custom Outfit Pack: Contains 3 costume sets and 1 weapon

Expansion DLC: Mask of Idris




[hr][/hr]

Pre-order now to receive the following bonuses:
Stylized Forma Set

Forma Face Paint: A cosmetic item which applies a forma design to the corner of your eyes.

Twin Fangs of the Lone Wolf (Weapon): Twin blades engraved with a special forma. Cut through your enemies like a wolf sinking its teeth into its prey with a powerful, lunging slice attack.

notes.title: Code Vein II – Some story and lore details revealed
notes.content:
Two worlds collide, new revenants rise. 

Unravel the dark tale of CODE VEIN II and discover what binds past and present. Ready to bleed for the truth?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649559/e858489c59104b9255d7ce07a2cee8b630f603b5.jpg"]

Code Vein II was officially unveiled on June 6th during the 2025 Summer Game Fest, exciting fans of the franchise with the announcement of a brand-new chapter in the Code Vein universe.

This upcoming action RPG from Bandai Namco Studios Inc. marks a major return for the series.
New details about the game’s story and lore have also been revealed… Discover everything we know so far HERE !

Discover more :[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362060/CODE_VEIN_II/"][/dynamiclink]
